ideas.name: Roof-window blackout cover, universal cut-to-fit
ideas.concept: Magnetic/velcro-edge blackout + heat-reflective panel sized to common roof-window frames (e.g. 78x98, 114x118), cut-to-fit marks.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic attic/loft owners and renters with roof windows and bright summer nights
ideas.problem_solved: Light-night sleep disruption and attic overheating without buying OEM blinds
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (credits/budget exhausted). Based on founder domain knowledge that Nordic midnight-sun light and attic heat are recurring pain points.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fit-chart by roof-window size and proprietary laminate stack; compatibility database as brand moat.

ideas.name: Window condensation channel strip kit
ideas.concept: Self-adhesive absorbent strip plus drip channel for window sills/frames, with reusable refill cores.
ideas.target_customer: Homeowners and renters in older double-glazed homes
ideas.problem_solved: Winter condensation pooling and frame mould (non-medical, cosmetic/home care)
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible this run; unverified that demand is rising. Needs Google Trends/Amazon check.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Refill subscription, branded refill format; extruded profile via custom die (low cost).

ideas.name: Draught-seal tape with Nordic frame profiles
ideas.concept: Window/door sealing strips sold as sized sets by gap profile with a gap-measuring card.
ideas.problem_solved: Choosing the right seal thickness; draughts and heat loss
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: energy-cost-driven draught-proofing interest assumed, not verified this run.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Gap-gauge selector and install guidance content; risk: Biltema/Jula already sell basic tape.

ideas.name: Reflective summer heat-shield for windows
ideas.concept: Reusable reflective insert panels pressed into window reveals, sized sets for roof and wall windows.
ideas.problem_solved: Summer overheating, no-drill, no external installation
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no live data; heat-wave growth in Northern Europe is general knowledge only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Daylight-versus-heat design expertise; tested g-value claims via lab data.

ideas.name: Window-film privacy and daylight diffuser sets
ideas.concept: Static-cling frosted/gradient films designed to keep daylight while hiding views, pre-cut for standard panes.
ideas.target_customer: City apartment renters, ground-floor and bathroom windows
ideas.problem_solved: Privacy without losing daylight or damaging glazing
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: category is likely crowded on Amazon; flagged as risk, not confirmed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Original Scandinavian pattern designs (design IP, copyright).
